2. Title: **"Shadows & Pearls"** (stylized in elegant gold font with a shimmer effect).  
3. Tagline: *"Beneath the glitz lies a deadly secret."*  
4. Background: Add a bustling city skyline at sunset with a shadowy, mysterious ambiance.  
5. Enhance lighting to create a golden hour glow on the subject, matching luxury and intrigue feelings.  
6. Include a sleek silhouette of a helicopter and a luxury yacht subtly in the bottom corner for an action vibe.  
7. Add "Starring [Placeholder Name]" at the top, stylized in a sleek serif font.  
8. Quotes: Add two quotes, “A mesmerizing thriller!” - Lux Magazine, and “The must-watch of the year!” - Empire Weekly.  
9. Bottom credits: Add traditional movie poster credits with detailed production names, fictional director, producers, and collaborators in small text.  
10. Apply a grainy film effect for added cinematic quality.
